about_the_game:
The story takes place in a post-apocalyptic world where only two humans have survived: the protagonist and the hero.

You will assume the role of the protagonist as she fights to survive alongside Harunashi Mika, the game's hero.

The game itself is a visual novel where the player will be frequently required to make tough choices in order to guide the characters through the harsh and unforgiving world they find themselves in.

Your choices will cause their relationship to develop and determine the conclusion of the story.

There are a wide variety of different endings.

The protagonist and Mika might simply work together to survive; they might develop romantic feelings for one another and become a new Adam and Eve; they might be unable to find common ground and go their separate ways.

Perhaps there are even endings where they choose to give up on life entirely...

Everything is determined by your choices!

----------

Genre: Otome Game

Number of Endings: 17 (including bad endings)

----------

[Disclaimers]

This game is a work of fiction.

Names, characters, businesses, places, events and incidents are either the products of the author’s imagination or used in a fictitious manner. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, or actual events is purely coincidental.

Please be aware that due to the post-apocalyptic setting, there are depictions of ruined buildings and of natural disasters such as typhoons and floods.

Additionally, this is a mature story featuring depictions of violence, smoking, blood, accidents, suicide, physical injury, and sexual contact between adults.

The year is 2685 A.D. Technology has developed to the point where humans can control even the weather!

Virtual reality tech is also highly advanced, allowing people to fully immerse themselves in virtual worlds offering unprecedented experiences.

~A post-apocalyptic world where humanity is nearly extinct. How would the survivors think and act in such an environment?~

The protagonist decides to participate in Navigatore, a new VR project produced by a popular internet program. There she meets with Harunashi Mika and decides to partner up with him.

When the two awaken and step outside, they find themselves in a barren, deserted landscape... one seemingly far too realistic to be the product of virtual reality.

As they get their bearings, they hear the voice of the program's announcer:

"A man and a woman placed in extreme conditions... can they survive? How will they survive? The audience is dying to find out! We're hoping for plenty of human drama and maybe a bit of romance!"

"The guided part of the tour is over. Your life in the wasteland begins now! We shall await the conclusion of your story with bated breath!"

An average university student who moved out of her family home less than a year ago.

Has an unassuming appearance, but her friends know she's not to be underestimated. Possesses keen social intelligence and acts with conviction.

A bright and confident person, she is also exceptionally patient and understanding.

However, this means that she is inclined to bottle it up inside when something is bothering her, occasionally resulting in outbursts of emotion with serious repercussions...

Her hobby is watching game streams.

A freelance engineer who does nothing outside of work except play games, never leaving his room.

His penchant for gaming has led to him becoming an FPS streamer.

Not especially fond or trusting of other people, but a reliable friend to those he has become close with, being very protective of them as well.

He had an unhappy childhood; his father spent all of his time at work, and his mother was the stereotypical helicopter parent.

Forced to participate in Navigatore after his father signs him up without his permission.
